text: For the leader. Do not destroy. [1] A miktam of David.
I Do you indeed pronounce justice, O gods; [2]do you judge fairly you children of Adam? [AA]
No, you freely engage in crime;your hands dispense violence to the earth.
II The wicked have been corrupt since birth;liars from the womb, they have gone astray.
t[3]Their venom is like the venom of a snake,like that of a serpent stopping its ears, [AB]
So as not to hear the voice of the charmeror the enchanter with cunning spells.
III O God, smash the teeth in their mouths;break the fangs of these lions, Lord! [AC]
Make them vanish like water flowing away; [AD]trodden down, let them wither like grass. [AE]
Let them dissolve like a snail that oozes away, [4]like an untimely birth that never sees the sun. [AF]
Suddenly, like brambles or thistles,have the whirlwind snatch them away. [AG]
Then the just shall rejoice to see the vengeanceand bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked. [AH]
Then people will say:"Truly there is a reward for the just;there is a God who is judge on earth!"
